name: gizza-ai/randomize-palette
summary: Randomly remap an indexed image's palette

tool.description: Randomly remap the color palette of an indexed GIF/PNG-8 image — every pixel keeps its index but each palette slot is reassigned a different color, so shapes and stego payloads hidden by near-identical palette entries become visible. Images with more than 256 colors are quantized to 256 first. The shuffle is driven by seed (default 0) so results are reproducible; change seed to try a different shuffle. Returns a PNG. Provide the image as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref from a prior tool call.

url.description: Image URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

seed.description: Seed for the random palette permutation (default 0). The same seed always produces the same remap; change it to try a different shuffle and reveal different hidden structure.
